data.rationale: The proposal gets the overall procedure and order right (GitHub search, profile, top repo stats, blog post, then the email with the correct subject and body templates), but it has gaps that would hurt automation: it has no {blog} URL parameter, so 'find the latest blog post' is vague; it turns the fixed recipient hiring@example.com into a parameter; and it says 'save or send' when the user actually clicked Discard without sending.
